# Reclazz

**Free, open-source hot reload for Java, Spring and SAP Commerce.**
Edit, compile and see supported changes in the running JVM.

[Documentation](https://reclazz.com/docs/) · [Reload support](https://reclazz.com/docs/support-matrix/) · [Website](https://reclazz.com) · [Releases](https://github.com/onurkat/reclazz/releases)

## Documentation scope

Source version 1.7.0; evidence baseline 75535bd739d7eefd43523dcc63799436c472fe12; reviewed 2026-10-19.
Source presence does not establish release availability or acceptance on every runtime.
Read each support condition and verify the running application.

## Guides and references

- [Overview](https://reclazz.com/docs/): Choose a setup, make your first change and understand when a restart is needed.
- [Quickstart](https://reclazz.com/docs/quickstart/): Choose your launch route, compile one small edit and check its result in the same JVM.
- [What reloads](https://reclazz.com/docs/support-matrix/): Find your edit, its conditions and your next step.
- [SAP Commerce](https://reclazz.com/docs/sap-commerce/): Set up once, find your edit and verify the running server.
- [Spring & MVC](https://reclazz.com/docs/spring/): Check beans, endpoints and listener delivery after a save.
- [Configuration & resources](https://reclazz.com/docs/configuration/): Find the runtime resource and verify its current value.
- [Persistence & caches](https://reclazz.com/docs/persistence/): Check mappings, schema and cached results separately.
- [Java & JVM limits](https://reclazz.com/docs/java/): Find your edit and understand the runtime it needs.
- [Troubleshooting](https://reclazz.com/docs/troubleshooting/): Start with the symptom, check the IDE diagnostic and recover safely.
- [Agent options](https://reclazz.com/docs/configuration-reference/): Set common options in IntelliJ or the application JVM argument.
- [Versions & evidence](https://reclazz.com/docs/evidence/): Read support claims with their exact boundaries, inspect source and help keep the documentation honest.
- [Installation](https://reclazz.com/docs/reference/installation/): Complete configuration, behavior and scope reference: Installation.
- [Usage manual](https://reclazz.com/docs/reference/usage/): Complete configuration, behavior and scope reference: Usage Guide.
- [Gradle plugin](https://reclazz.com/docs/reference/gradle-plugin/): Complete configuration, behavior and scope reference: Reclazz Gradle plugin.
- [Maven plugin](https://reclazz.com/docs/reference/maven/): Complete configuration, behavior and scope reference: Reclazz with Maven.
- [Spring Boot starter](https://reclazz.com/docs/reference/spring-boot-starter/): Complete configuration, behavior and scope reference: Reclazz Spring Boot starter.
- [IntelliJ + coding agents](https://reclazz.com/docs/reference/for-ai-agents/): Complete configuration, behavior and scope reference: For AI agents.
- [MCP for coding agents](https://reclazz.com/docs/reference/mcp-for-coding-agents/): Complete configuration, behavior and scope reference: MCP for coding agents: close the loop.
- [MCP server reference](https://reclazz.com/docs/reference/mcp-server/): Complete configuration, behavior and scope reference: Reclazz MCP server.
- [SAP Commerce reference](https://reclazz.com/docs/reference/sap-commerce/): Complete configuration, behavior and scope reference: Reclazz on SAP Commerce, for a coding agent.
- [SAP test guide](https://reclazz.com/docs/reference/test-guide/): Complete configuration, behavior and scope reference: Reclazz: Test Guide for SAP Commerce (Hybris).
- [What reloads source table](https://reclazz.com/docs/reference/reload-support/): Complete configuration, behavior and scope reference: Reload support reference.
